meta.name: git-safety
meta.description: Critical safety guardrails for protected branches: never commit, push, or force-push directly to main, latest, or release branches; no destructive history rewrites without explicit user approval. Use before any git operation that touches protected branches, before force-push, reset --hard, history rewrite, or branch deletion, or whenever the user asks about merging, pushing, or release branches.

copy.tagline: 防止对受保护分支的误操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常操作git且担心误推或误删保护分支
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use git and worry about accidental pushes or deletions on protected branches

howto.what: Claude 会严格禁止直接提交、推送或强制推送到 main、latest 和 release/ 等保护分支，必须通过功能分支和 Pull Request 来合并代码，并在执行 Git 操作前自动检查当前分支是否安全。
howto.when: 当 Claude 即将执行涉及保护分支的 Git 操作（如提交、推送、合并），或用户要求强制推送、重置、重写历史或删除分支时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动直接提交到 main 分支。
say.note: Claude 会阻止该操作并提示使用功能分支。

say.text: 创建一个功能分支并推送代码。
say.note: Claude 允许操作并指导创建 PR。

say.text: 强制推送到 release/v2.0.0 分支。
say.note: Claude 会要求确认并拒绝破坏性操作。

howto.what_en: Claude will strictly prevent direct commits, pushes, or force pushes to protected branches like main, latest, and release/*. Changes must go through feature branches and Pull Requests. It auto-checks branch safety before any Git operation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is about to perform Git operations on protected branches, or when the user mentions force-push, reset, history rewrite, branch deletion, merge, push, or release branches.

say_en.text: Commit my changes directly to main.
say_en.note: Claude blocks it and suggests a feature branch.

say_en.text: Create a feature branch and push code.
say_en.note: Claude allows and guides PR creation.
